A complete outer cache container is not serialized or persisted by this measurement; the framing cost is included arithmetically. Full decoder state charged once. Sampled full-cache estimates assume measured bytes per record and are not full-cache measurements.

memory.scope: Allocator allocated bytes during this bounded operation, excluding pre-existing model/state baseline; reserved memory and host allocations are separate.

measurement.rotation_basis: No preloaded rotation; any generated gpu_ops basis is identified by its recorded SHA256.

decoder_state_info.accounting: Actual distinct tensor storage bytes, including lazily created rotations; Python metadata and allocator reserved bytes are not included.

measurement.scope: Separately named tensor packet format, not a GPU implementation of the CPU entropy wire formats. Record input CPU→device staging, device encode and device decode are separately synchronized. Full cache is not retained on accelerator. Packet JSON headers and all physical tensor payload bytes are measured; specified 32-byte cache framing and offset costs are added arithmetically, with no complete outer container persisted. Prefetched validated host launch descriptors and CPU descriptor guards are included in native execution; authoritative JSON header parsing/validation occurs during explicit packet transfer/restore. CPU runs establish functionality only. No attention, concurrency, or admission benefit is measured.

recipe_analysis.scope: One standard benchmark case; DEV and TEST are never combined. Actual native packet records only, separate from direct-prefill observer measurements and CPU reference codecs. Savings include all measured packet components, calculated outer framing and full decoder state once. An estimate is not a full-cache measurement.

stateless_size_oracle.scope: SIZE-ONLY oracle over packets that were all separately encoded. One byte per record for the selected mode plus specified cache header/index costs. No packet repacking or online selector exists here; selection compute, mode dispatch latency, encoder work, and attention benefit are not measured. This is not an implemented prefill policy or a latency result.
stateless_size_oracle.accounting: Selected actual inner record bytes + 1 mode byte per record + 32-byte cache header + 8*(record_count+1) offset bytes; no external decoder state. Full-cache estimates scale selected inner+mode bytes by total/measured before adding full framing. A mode table/dispatcher implementation is not serialized or benchmarked.

sample_decode.scope: Sample packet already on target device for each isolated decode call; explicit packet copy and authoritative header parsing excluded. Decode includes CPU launch-descriptor guards. One warmup.

sample_packet_transfer_then_decode.scope: Explicit per-field pageable packet CPU→device copy plus synchronized device decode, allocation and authoritative JSON header validation included. CPU functional copy when no accelerator. Reconstructed-word validation D2H excluded.

measurement.name: native_prefill_affine_dictionary64_channel_g8_residual
measurement.byte_accounting: Actual selected-record payload bytes plus calculated costs for the specified 32-byte cache header and 8*(record_count+1) index bytes. A complete outer cache container is not serialized or persisted by this measurement; the framing cost is included arithmetically. Full decoder state charged once. Sampled full-cache estimates assume measured bytes per record and are not full-cache measurements.

memory.scope: Allocator allocated bytes during this bounded operation, excluding pre-existing model/state baseline; reserved memory and host allocations are separate.

measurement.rotation_basis: No preloaded rotation; any generated gpu_ops basis is identified by its recorded SHA256.

decoder_state_info.accounting: Conservative maximum of complete serialized residual model and actual distinct device tensor storage; both quantities reported separately.

model_config.assignment_tie_break: minimum circular L1, then first dictionary index
model_config.fit_objective: circular zigzag group-width assignment; coordinate median L1 updates; fixed zero prototype

measurement.scope: Separately named tensor packet format, not a GPU implementation of the CPU entropy wire formats. Record input CPU→device staging, device encode and device decode are separately synchronized. Full cache is not retained on accelerator. Packet JSON headers and all physical tensor payload bytes are measured; specified 32-byte cache framing and offset costs are added arithmetically, with no complete outer container persisted. Prefetched validated host launch descriptors and CPU descriptor guards are included in native execution; authoritative JSON header parsing/validation occurs during explicit packet transfer/restore. CPU runs establish functionality only. No attention, concurrency, or admission benefit is measured.

prefill_recipes.scope: Synchronous instrumentation between prefill chunks. Capture prefill timing includes observer work; do not compare it to an uninstrumented capture as pure model prefill time.

state_contract.accounting: Actual distinct tensor storage bytes, including lazily created rotations; Python metadata and allocator reserved bytes are not included.
state_contract.scope: Full decoder_state_bytes follows the reported state contract and is charged once per candidate cache, never once per record or per K/V subtotal. Physical tensor and serialized model bytes are reported separately; they are not assumed identical.

timing.scope: Normalized by original raw BF16 bytes in each timing sample. Repeated timing may use a smaller sample than byte-accounting records. CPU tensor runs are functionality checks, not GPU timings.

stateless_size_oracle.scope: SIZE-ONLY oracle over packets that were all separately encoded. One byte per record for the selected mode plus specified cache header/index costs. This is not an implemented prefill policy or a latency result.
stateless_size_oracle.accounting: Selected actual inner record bytes + 1 mode byte per record + 32-byte cache header + 8*(record_count+1) offset bytes; no external decoder state. Full-cache estimates scale selected inner+mode bytes by total/measured before adding full framing. A mode table/dispatcher implementation is not serialized or benchmarked.

memory.scope: Allocator allocated bytes during this bounded operation, excluding pre-existing model/state baseline; reserved memory and host allocations are separate.

measurement.name: native_prefill_exponent_affine_channel_tiered
measurement.byte_accounting: Actual selected-record payload bytes plus calculated costs for the specified 32-byte cache header and 8*(record_count+1) index bytes. A complete outer cache container is not serialized or persisted by this measurement; the framing cost is included arithmetically. Full decoder state charged once. Sampled full-cache estimates assume measured bytes per record and are not full-cache measurements.

memory.scope: Allocator allocated bytes during this bounded operation, excluding pre-existing model/state baseline; reserved memory and host allocations are separate.

measurement.rotation_basis: No preloaded rotation; any generated gpu_ops basis is identified by its recorded SHA256.

decoder_state_info.accounting: Actual distinct tensor storage bytes, including lazily created rotations; Python metadata and allocator reserved bytes are not included.

measurement.scope: Separately named tensor packet format, not a GPU implementation of the CPU entropy wire formats. Record input CPU→device staging, device encode and device decode are separately synchronized. Full cache is not retained on accelerator. Prefetched validated host launch descriptors and CPU descriptor guards are included in native execution; authoritative JSON header parsing/validation occurs during explicit packet transfer/restore. CPU runs establish functionality only. No attention, concurrency, or admission benefit is measured.

recipe_analysis.scope: One standard benchmark case; DEV and TEST are never combined. Actual native packet records only, separate from direct-prefill observer measurements and CPU reference codecs. Savings include all measured packet components, calculated outer framing and full decoder state once. An estimate is not a full-cache measurement.

stateless_size_oracle.scope: SIZE-ONLY oracle over packets that were all separately encoded. One byte per record for the selected mode plus specified cache header/index costs. No packet repacking or online selector exists here; selection compute, mode dispatch latency, encoder work, and attention benefit are not measured. This is not an implemented prefill policy or a latency result.
stateless_size_oracle.accounting: Selected actual inner record bytes + 1 mode byte per record + 32-byte cache header + 8*(record_count+1) offset bytes; no external decoder state. Full-cache estimates scale selected inner+mode bytes by total/measured before adding full framing. A mode table/dispatcher implementation is not serialized or benchmarked.

sample_decode.scope: Sample packet already on target device for each isolated decode call; explicit packet copy and authoritative header parsing excluded. Decode includes CPU launch-descriptor guards. One warmup.

sample_packet_transfer_then_decode.scope: Explicit per-field pageable packet CPU→device copy plus synchronized device decode, allocation and authoritative JSON header validation included. CPU functional copy when no accelerator. Reconstructed-word validation D2H excluded.

measurement.name: native_prefill_exponent_fixed127_time_tiered
measurement.byte_accounting: Actual selected-record payload bytes plus calculated costs for the specified 32-byte cache header and 8*(record_count+1) index bytes. A complete outer cache container is not serialized or persisted by this measurement; the framing cost is included arithmetically. Full decoder state charged once. Sampled full-cache estimates assume measured bytes per record and are not full-cache measurements.

memory.scope: Allocator allocated bytes during this bounded operation, excluding pre-existing model/state baseline; reserved memory and host allocations are separate.

measurement.rotation_basis: No preloaded rotation; any generated gpu_ops basis is identified by its recorded SHA256.

decoder_state_info.accounting: Actual distinct tensor storage bytes, including lazily created rotations; Python metadata and allocator reserved bytes are not included.

measurement.scope: Separately named tensor packet format, not a GPU implementation of the CPU entropy wire formats. Record input CPU→device staging, device encode and device decode are separately synchronized. Full cache is not retained on accelerator. Packet JSON headers and all physical tensor payload bytes are measured; specified 32-byte cache framing and offset costs are added arithmetically, with no complete outer container persisted. Prefetched validated host launch descriptors and CPU descriptor guards are included in native execution; authoritative JSON header parsing/validation occurs during explicit packet transfer/restore. CPU runs establish functionality only. No attention, concurrency, or admission benefit is measured.

stateless_size_oracle.scope: SIZE-ONLY oracle over packets that were all separately encoded. One byte per record for the selected mode plus specified cache header/index costs. stateless_size_oracle.accounting: Selected actual inner record bytes + 1 mode byte per record + 32-byte cache header + 8*(record_count+1) offset bytes; no external decoder state. capture.prefill_observer_scope: Synchronous observer after every prefill chunk, before the next chunk and final CPU export; observer work is included in prefill timing. Complete raw device KV remains resident.

measurement.byte_accounting: Actual selected-record payload bytes plus calculated costs for the specified 32-byte cache header and 8*(record_count+1) index bytes. A complete outer cache container is not serialized or persisted by this measurement; the framing cost is included arithmetically. Full decoder state charged once. Sampled full-cache estimates assume measured bytes per record and are not full-cache measurements.

state_contract.scope: Full decoder_state_bytes follows the reported state contract and is charged once per candidate cache, never once per record or per K/V subtotal. Physical tensor and serialized model bytes are reported separately; they are not assumed identical.

timing.scope: Normalized by original raw BF16 bytes in each timing sample. Repeated timing may use a smaller sample than byte-accounting records. CPU tensor runs are functionality checks, not GPU timings.

measurement.scope: Separately named tensor packet format, not a GPU implementation of the CPU entropy wire formats. Record input CPU→device staging, device encode and device decode are separately synchronized. Full cache is not retained on accelerator. Packet JSON headers and all physical tensor payload bytes are measured; specified 32-byte cache framing and offset costs are added arithmetically, with no complete outer container persisted. Prefetched validated host launch descriptors and CPU descriptor guards are included in native execution; authoritative JSON header parsing/validation occurs during explicit packet transfer/restore. CPU runs establish functionality only. No attention, concurrency, or admission benefit is measured.

prefill_recipe.prediction_scope: same-tile affine prefill metadata plus frozen TRAIN residual dictionary
prefill_recipe.diagnostics_source: host packet description and tensor sizes; no device-to-host value reads

sample_decode.scope: Sample packet already on target device for each isolated decode call; explicit packet copy and authoritative header parsing excluded. Decode includes CPU launch-descriptor guards. One warmup.

sample_packet_transfer_then_decode.scope: Explicit per-field pageable packet CPU→device copy plus synchronized device decode, allocation and authoritative JSON header validation included. CPU functional copy when no accelerator. Reconstructed-word validation D2H excluded.

measurement.name: native_prefill_affine_dictionary16_time_g8_residual
measurement.byte_accounting: Actual selected-record payload bytes plus calculated costs for the specified 32-byte cache header and 8*(record_count+1) index bytes. A complete outer cache container is not serialized or persisted by this measurement; the framing cost is included arithmetically. Full decoder state charged once. Sampled full-cache estimates assume measured bytes per record and are not full-cache measurements.

memory.scope: Allocator allocated bytes during this bounded operation, excluding pre-existing model/state baseline; reserved memory and host allocations are separate.

measurement.rotation_basis: No preloaded rotation; any generated gpu_ops basis is identified by its recorded SHA256.

decoder_state_info.accounting: Conservative maximum of complete serialized residual model and actual distinct device tensor storage; both quantities reported separately.

state_contract.scope: Full decoder_state_bytes follows the reported state contract and is charged once per candidate cache, never once per record or per K/V subtotal. Physical tensor and serialized model bytes are reported separately; they are not assumed identical.

timing.scope: Normalized by original raw BF16 bytes in each timing sample. Repeated timing may use a smaller sample than byte-accounting records. CPU tensor runs are functionality checks, not GPU timings.

recipe_analysis.scope: One standard benchmark case; DEV and TEST are never combined. Actual native packet records only, separate from direct-prefill observer measurements and CPU reference codecs. Savings include all measured packet components, calculated outer framing and full decoder state once. An estimate is not a full-cache measurement.

stateless_size_oracle.scope: SIZE-ONLY oracle over packets that were all separately encoded. One byte per record for the selected mode plus specified cache header/index costs. No packet repacking or online selector exists here; selection compute, mode dispatch latency, encoder work, and attention benefit are not measured. This is not an implemented prefill policy or a latency result.
stateless_size_oracle.accounting: Selected actual inner record bytes + 1 mode byte per record + 32-byte cache header + 8*(record_count+1) offset bytes; no external decoder state. Full-cache estimates scale selected inner+mode bytes by total/measured before adding full framing. A mode table/dispatcher implementation is not serialized or benchmarked.
